llm_models.name: Qwen3 0.6B
llm_models.notes: Alibaba Qwen3 0.6B — fits on CPU, useful for edge/testing. Thinking mode available but token-limited.

llm_models.name: Qwen3 1.7B
llm_models.notes: Strong reasoning for 1.7B. Good for low-resource devices. Thinking mode surprisingly capable.

llm_models.name: Qwen3 4B
llm_models.notes: Best-in-class 4B model. Tool use + thinking at this size is rare. Excellent for companion chat on constrained hardware.

llm_models.name: Qwen3 8B
llm_models.notes: The recommended sweet-spot for 8GB VRAM. Excellent instruction following, tools, and reasoning. Abliterated variants available for mature RP.

llm_models.name: Qwen3 14B
llm_models.notes: Jumps noticeably in quality over 8B. Eva-Qwen2.5-14B and similar fine-tunes make it the top RP choice on 16GB GPUs.

llm_models.name: Qwen3 32B
llm_models.notes: Near GPT-4 level reasoning with thinking mode. Requires 24GB VRAM at Q4. Strong creative writing and character consistency.

llm_models.name: Llama 3.2 1B
llm_models.notes: Meta Llama 3.2 1B — incredibly small, 128k context. Best for edge / embedded use cases.

llm_models.name: Llama 3.2 3B
llm_models.notes: Llama 3.2 3B with 128k context. Rogue Creative Uncensored 3B is the top RP fine-tune at this size.

llm_models.name: Llama 3.1 8B
llm_models.notes: Stheno v3.4 and Dark-Planet are the top RP fine-tunes. Tool use via function-calling.

llm_models.name: Llama 3.1 70B
llm_models.notes: Midnight Miqu 70B is the legendary RP fine-tune. Requires multi-GPU or very high-end single GPU.

llm_models.name: Gemma 3 1B
llm_models.notes: Google Gemma 3 1B — strong for its size. Good reasoning but limited creative writing.

llm_models.name: Gemma 3 4B
llm_models.notes: Vision-capable at 4B is impressive. Abliterated variants available. Better for instruction following than deep RP.

llm_models.name: Gemma 3 12B
llm_models.notes: Gemma3-Instruct-Abliterated 12B has 16K+ Ollama pulls. Strong reasoning base, good creative writing when abliterated.

llm_models.name: Gemma 3 27B
llm_models.notes: Barely fits 16GB at Q4. Abliterated variant produces rich, detailed prose. Google's base model quality shines through.

llm_models.name: Phi-4 Mini 3.8B
llm_models.notes: Microsoft Phi-4 Mini — exceptional reasoning at 3.8B, tool use capable. Not ideal for RP but excels at coding and Q&A.

llm_models.name: Phi-4 14B
llm_models.notes: Microsoft Phi-4 14B — benchmark champion at this size class. Strong instruction following. Abliterated variants decent for RP.

llm_models.name: Mistral 7B v0.3
llm_models.notes: The original Mistral 7B — foundational for Dolphin, MythoMax, and many RP fine-tunes. Excellent instruction following.

llm_models.name: Mistral Small 3.1 24B
llm_models.notes: Mistral Small 3.1 abliterated has French-flair prose, elegant emotional beats. Vision capable. Fits 16GB at Q4.

llm_models.name: Lumimaid 8B
llm_models.notes: Top choice for anime roleplay. Specialized for character interaction with excellent personality consistency. Very fast inference.

llm_models.name: Eva Qwen 2.5 14B
llm_models.notes: Fine-tuned for roleplaying and NSFW storytelling on Qwen 2.5 base. Praised as best uncensored RP on Apple Silicon. Emotionally rich character voices.

llm_models.name: L3.1-8B-Stheno v3.4
llm_models.notes: By Sao10K — multi-stage finetuned Llama 3.1. Community favorite for anime chat with 128k context. Punches above its weight class.

llm_models.name: Dolphin 3.0 Abliterated 8B
llm_models.notes: Eric Hartford's Dolphin 3.0 abliterated by huihui_ai. 60K+ Ollama pulls. Trained on data with alignment removed + abliteration. Excellent instruction following.

llm_models.name: Rocinante 12B v1.1
llm_models.notes: Community-beloved 12B merge that punches into 20B+ territory for creative writing. Great world-building, emotionally rich character interactions.

llm_models.name: Dark Champion MoE v2 21B
llm_models.notes: DavidAU's MoE masterpiece. 8x4B architecture runs faster than expected at 21B. Detail and prose described as off-the-scale.

tts_models.name: Kokoro 82M
tts_models.notes: Extremely lightweight, <200ms latency. Already integrated in waifu-rt3d TTS pipeline. Best for low-end hardware.

tts_models.name: GPT-SoVITS
tts_models.notes: Top choice for anime character voices. Voice cloning from short audio clips. Very natural, expressive speech. Needs 4-8GB VRAM.

tts_models.name: Fish Speech S2
tts_models.notes: High-quality synthesis with voice cloning. Fast and efficient. 3-6GB VRAM. Excellent for character voices.

tts_models.name: Hume TADA 3B
tts_models.notes: Text-Acoustic Dual-Alignment on Llama 3.2 3B. 1:1 token alignment eliminates hallucination. Dynamic prosody per token. Near real-time. 10 languages.

tts_models.name: Dia 1.6B Dialogue TTS
tts_models.notes: Multi-speaker dialogue TTS with [S1]/[S2] tags. Supports non-verbals: (laughs), (sighs), (gasps). 44.1kHz output. Perfect for anime dialogue scenes.

tts_models.name: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B CustomVoice
tts_models.notes: 97ms end-to-end streaming latency. Instruction-controlled emotion. 9 voice presets including Ono_Anna (playful Japanese female). 10 languages.

tts_models.name: VoiceVox
tts_models.notes: Japanese-specialized TTS with anime-style voice presets. Multiple character voices. The go-to for Japanese anime content.

tts_models.name: Piper TTS
tts_models.notes: Very lightweight and fast. Good for accessibility and low-resource setups. Many language models available.

tts_models.name: F5-TTS
tts_models.notes: Lightweight voice cloning with minimal VRAM. Good balance of quality and efficiency. Voice cloning from short reference clips.

tts_models.name: ElevenLabs
tts_models.notes: Premium cloud TTS with exceptional quality. Voice cloning. Requires API key. Best cloud option for production.

stt_models.name: Whisper Large v3
stt_models.notes: OpenAI Whisper Large v3 — gold standard for accuracy across 99 languages. Best offline STT for multilingual use.

stt_models.name: Whisper Large v3 Turbo
stt_models.notes: Distilled Whisper Large v3 — 6x faster than full Large with minimal accuracy loss. Best balance of speed and accuracy.

stt_models.name: Faster-Whisper Large v3
stt_models.notes: CTranslate2-accelerated Whisper. Up to 4x faster than vanilla Whisper with same accuracy. Used in waifu-rt3d voice pipeline.

stt_models.name: Anime Whisper (litagin)
stt_models.notes: Whisper Large V3 distilled + fine-tuned on 5,300 hours of anime/VN speech. Beats base Whisper on anime CER (13.0 vs 16.5). Captures stuttering, laughter, breathing. The gold standard for Japanese anime STT.

stt_models.name: Distil-Whisper Large v3
stt_models.notes: HuggingFace distilled Whisper for English — 5.8x faster than Whisper Large v3 with 1% accuracy drop. Best for English-only real-time voice.

stt_models.name: Voxtral Mini 4B
stt_models.notes: Mistral's realtime STT — <500ms latency, 13 languages, streaming architecture for infinite audio input. First open-source realtime STT matching offline accuracy.
